description: Print the last 10 lines of each FILE to standard output.

option.name: --follow
tip: Print the file as it grows

option.name: --max-unchanged-stats
tip: Reopen a FILE which has not changed size after N (default 5) iterations to see if it has been unlinked or renamed (this is the usual case of rotated log files); This option is meaningful only when polling (i.e., with --use-polling) and when --follow=name

option.name: --pid
tip: With -f, terminate after process ID, PID dies

option.name: --quiet
tip: Never output headers giving file names

option.name: --retry
tip: Keep trying to open a file if it is inaccessible

option.name: --sleep-interval
tip: Number of seconds to sleep between polling the file when running with -f

option.name: --use-polling
tip: Disable 'inotify' support and use polling instead

option.name: --verbose
tip: Always output headers giving file names

option.name: --zero-terminated
tip: Line delimiter is NUL, not newline
